claims.statement: The frontend/src/lib/api/ subfolder holds the API client — index.ts is the barrel re-exporting api (the fetch wrapper from client.ts), ApiError + formatErrorMessage (Vietnamese Zod field translation) from errors.ts, and getAuthenticatedPhotoUrl from photo.ts; tests live in frontend/src/lib/api.test.ts.

frontend/src/lib/format.ts provides Vietnamese-locale formatters: formatNumber (vi-VN, . thousands separator), formatCompact (>=1B tỷ / >=1M tr / >=1K k), formatCurrency ("12.500.000 ₫"), moneyParts splitting a VND amount into { num, unit, format } so the unit renders at subtitle size (the basis of the shared <Money> component), and formatDateTimeVN which forces timeZone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' explicitly because a vi-VN locale argument alone does not set the zone. moneyInput.ts parses numeric fields treating Vietnamese dots as thousands separators, with blank input kept undefined.

frontend/src/lib/date.ts contains exactly two helpers: formatDayMonth (DD/MM) and formatRelativeTime (Vừa xong, N phút trước, N giờ trước, Hôm qua, N ngày trước, then a DD/MM date after a week); the former month-name and week-start utilities no longer exist in the file.

frontend/src/lib/round.ts is a re-export shim of round2dp from @tingting/shared so pages can `import { round2dp } from '@/lib/round'` without importing from the shared package directly; the math lives in shared/src/calculations/round.ts.

frontend/src/lib/route.ts exports splitRoute(routeName), which splits "Hà Nội → Hải Phòng" into { from, to } by trying the separators →, ⇒, ->, ' - ', ' – ', > in order and returning null when none yields two non-empty halves; it is used by the dispatch trip card, trip mobile cards, and trip columns. routes.test.ts covers titleForPath and agent route keys, not splitRoute.

frontend/src/lib/maps.ts wraps the /maps endpoints with typed PlaceSuggestion / RouteSuggestion / RouteResult shapes and an in-memory autocomplete cache (50 entries, 5-minute TTL, oldest evicted). On the backend, maps.service.ts serves /maps/autocomplete and /maps/distance with distances drawn from GPS-captured route polylines, and the place-search module backend/src/services/map4d.ts is now Google Places Autocomplete (New) primary with a Geocoding fallback (Map4D is historical), fronted by Redis caching.

frontend/src/lib/cap-table.ts exports getActiveCapTable(entries), which picks the latest effectiveDate reached today (falling back to all rows when none is reached), dedupes to the most-recent createdAt per partner name, and computes percentages from contributionAmount — falling back to the stored percentage field when contributions sum to zero. csv.ts downloadCSV uses exceljs to produce brand-styled XLSX reports with a title band, columnTypes metadata, and a totals row labeled TỔNG CỘNG.

Other lib utilities: audit-helpers.ts (ACTION_LABELS, resolveCategory, formatTimeShort for audit-log rendering), calendar-month.ts getCalendarMonthRange (inclusive Gregorian month bounds, with tests), profit-preview.ts getProfitPreviewEmptyMessage (Vietnamese empty-state selection for profit distribution), expense-breakdown.ts groupExpensesByType/groupExpensesByContainer (per-category and chronological per-container totals), status-variants.ts (AdvanceRequestStatus/AdvanceSettlementStatus → neutral/info/warn/success/danger tokens), notificationClient.ts (notifications list/unread/mark-read + web-push VAPID subscribe/unsubscribe), emptyIllustrations.ts (empty-state category → PNG illustration map), and utils.ts which contains only cn (class-name joining).

frontend/src/lib/http/paginate.ts fetchAllPaginated walks a server-paginated list endpoint: it fetches page 1 with limit=100, computes totalPages from total, fetches remaining pages in batches of 5 concurrent requests (default concurrency), concatenates items in page order, and drops the total count. The page size matches the backend's shared parsePagination maxLimit of 100, which is the server-side convention that makes the helper necessary. configClient uses it for nearly every catalog list.

fetchAllPaginated fails atomically: because remaining pages are fetched with Promise.all, one failed page rejects the whole list so callers retry instead of displaying an incomplete catalog with incorrect totals; paginate.test.ts pins this failure semantics and order preservation under concurrent fetching.

frontend/src/lib/http/query.ts toQuery builds a query string from a record, skipping null, undefined, and empty-string values and stringifying numbers/booleans, returning '' when nothing remains; the api/*Client.ts modules compose request URLs from shared path constants plus toQuery.

The API client delegates token storage to design-system/hooks/useToken — the only module that touches localStorage['token'], with an in-memory cache invalidated by refreshTokenFromStorage; api.setToken/clearToken forward to it and the ApiClient constructor hydrates the cache eagerly so subsequent getToken() calls are O(1). Requests carry Authorization: Bearer when a token exists and Content-Type: application/json except for multipart uploads.

api.post and api.put accept opts.expectedUpdatedAt, which the client sends as an If-Unmodified-Since header (transport plumbing for conditional writes); the trip-figure saves that motivated it (updateTripPreDeparture/updateTripActuals) enforce the actual conflict server-side through the request body's version field, with updateTripFigures rejecting stale writes with 409.

A 401 on a request that carried a token is treated as an application-state transition, not a form error: the client clears the token and calls notifySessionExpired (a framework-agnostic listener set in api/session.ts); AuthProvider subscribes via onSessionExpired and runs logout, which cancels/removes all non-auth TanStack Query caches so nothing from the dead session is reused. A 401 without a token (bad login credentials) stays an ordinary ApiError.

Before surfacing any response (success or error, JSON or text/blob) the client's assertCurrentSession compares the token the request used against the current token and throws 'Phiên đăng nhập đã thay đổi. Vui lòng tải lại dữ liệu.' on mismatch — a late response from a replaced session can never populate another account's query cache, and writes are never retried automatically because the server may already have applied them.

errors.ts translates backend error bodies into Vietnamese user-facing messages: ApiError carries status, raw body, and the translated message; formatErrorMessage reads a Zod issue array under details, a plain string, or a structured object; FIELD_VI maps field paths to Vietnamese labels and MSG_VI maps Zod messages, stripping numeric indices for the label lookup while prefixing 'Chặng N — ' so users see which trip leg failed.

photo.ts solves authentication by appending the token as a query string to /api/photos/ URLs (getAuthenticatedPhotoUrl); photoSrc additionally accepts bare storage keys, encoding them into a single path segment for the wildcard photo route. The JWT-in-URL leak into nginx logs, browser history, and Referer headers is a documented known limitation, deliberately localized to this one file for a future migration to signed URLs or cookies.

frontend/src/lib/routes.ts is the frontend projection of the shared PAGE_CATALOG: static paths stay string constants and parametric paths stay functions whose signature requires the param (compile error if omitted); titleForPath walks a hand-ordered titleRules array whose order is the precedence logic, with title strings sourced from the catalog and a BRAND.name fallback; homeForRole resolves the post-login/404 home per role; legacy redirect aliases stay outside the catalog and RBAC is deliberately left to App.tsx guards + Casbin.

routes.test.ts is the regression net for routes.ts: a golden table asserts representative pathnames resolve to the same Vietnamese titles as before the catalog refactor, and a runtime test mirrors the compile-time catalog ↔ AGENT_ROUTE_KEYS parity assertion (35 keys).

frontend/src/lib/liveFleet.ts owns shared live-fleet marker rendering — LIVE_STATUS_COLOR/LIVE_STATUS_LABEL for moving/stopped/offline, liveMarkerIcon building a Leaflet DivIcon dot with a heading arrow when moving — and escapeHtml, which must wrap every GPS-sourced string interpolated into popup/tooltip HTML because Leaflet renders html via innerHTML and vendor address/driver fields arrive unescaped.

liveRoute.ts computeRemainingRoute projects the truck position onto each leg polyline, keeps candidate legs within ~2x the nearest leg's distance (tolerating GPS jitter and merging roads), and breaks the đi/về tie — a round trip retraces the same road — using the GPS heading versus each closest segment's bearing; the chosen leg's loadingType labels đi (HANG) vs về (VO), and the result carries the destination point, remaining path from the projection, and a true haversine distanceKm.

Live fleet data is polled by the useLiveFleet hook (10-second refetchInterval, enabled-gated so completed trips stop polling) via tripClient.getLiveFleet → /trips/live-fleet; LiveFleetMap clears and redraws markers each refresh and refits map bounds only when the truck set changes.

overlayState.ts answers 'is any overlay open?' for the ESC go-back shortcut via two layers: a module-level count registered by useAnimatedOverlay (Modal/Drawer/ConfirmDialog), useClickOutside with escapeKey, and PhotoViewer, plus a DOM fallback for portal'd role=dialog/alertdialog elements that bypass those hooks. The count is clamped at 0 and decremented on next-tick effect cleanup, so the ESC press that closes an overlay still sees it open and the next press navigates back.

chunk-error.ts self-heals stale-chunk load failures after deploys: installChunkErrorHandler (called in main.tsx before React mounts) detects chunk-failure messages on error/unhandledrejection, purges all service-worker caches, and reloads — capped at one reload per browser session via a sessionStorage counter, after which a Vietnamese fallback screen renders instead of looping. Route-level lazy chunks are normally caught by the App.tsx ErrorBoundary first; this is the safety net.

tourTarget.ts resolveTourTarget finds a spotlight anchor by data-tour-id first (via a CSS-escaped attribute selector) with a getElementById fallback, so legacy stable ids and new tour attributes both resolve; agentHighlight.ts highlightElement uses it to smooth-scroll and run a Driver.js spotlight for agent directives, returning false when no element matched so the agent can acknowledge honestly; tourTarget.test.ts pins precedence, escaping, and null cases.
